brainweb.format: raw256 (256x256 float32) + target128 (128x128 float32) per slice
brainweb.preprocessing: raw256 is an unnormalized float32 source slice; target128 is its exact 2x2 mean pool

hecktor.format: ct (144x144 float32 HU) + pet_input (144x144 float32 SUV-scale) per slice
hecktor.preprocessing: no transformation after extraction from HECKTOR.npz; provider states the upstream arrays are reconstructed PET/CT slices exported directly from clinical DICOM
hecktor.pet_unit: SUV (declared by data provider; source DICOM/NIfTI metadata is not included here)
hecktor.source_and_array_hash_status: not recorded in this first traceability export; regenerate with the revised exporter
hecktor.spatial_metadata_status: DICOM spatial tags are not retained in this NPZ; nonblocking for the declared pixel-domain full-square pseudo-sinogram operator
